This document provides an up-to-date listing of metadata files stored in 
`data/log/`.

## Table of Contents

- [Metadata Inventory](#metadata-inventory)
  - [Metadata Files in docs/metadata](#metadata-files-in-docsmetadata)

## Metadata Files in docs/metadata

```{r metadata-inventory, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(knitr)

folder <- "data"
subfolder <- "log"

# 1. List metadata files, including subdirectories (e.g. data-dictionaries/)
# 1. List metadata files, including subdirectories (e.g., data-dictionaries/)
metadata_files <- dir_info(here(folder, subfolder), recurse = TRUE) %>%
  filter(type == "file") %>%
  mutate(
    file_name = path_file(path),
    ext = path_ext(path),
    # Subdirectory within docs/metadata
    folder = path_rel(path_dir(path), start = here(folder, subfolder)),
    # Replace "." (top-level) with "metadata"
    folder = if_else(folder == ".", "metadata", folder)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    size_kb = round(size / 1024, 1),
    size_display = if_else(size < 1024, "<1 KB", paste0(size_kb, " KB")) #,
    # Optional: custom folder order
    #   folder = factor(folder,
    #                   levels = c("data-dictionaries",
    #                              "descriptions",
    #                              "look-up-tables",
    #                              "metadata",
    #                              "raster-data-summaries",
    #                              "vector-data-summaries")
    #                  )
  ) %>%
  arrange(folder, file_name) %>%
  select(folder, file_name, ext, size_display) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(file_name, "^README\\."))

file_descriptions <- tribble(
  ~file_name, ~description,
  "catchment_download_log.csv", "NHDPlusHD catchment download log",
  "duplicate_feature_summary.csv", "log of duplicate check for in data/processed feature data",
  "duplicate_raster_data_summary.csv", "log of duplicate check for in data/processed raster data",
  "ecoregion_download_log.csv", "EPA Ecoregion download log",
  "feature_file_inventory.csv", "data/processed feature data inventory",
  "koppen_climate_files_removed.csv", "log of Koppen-Geiger download files removed",
  "nhdphr_download_log.csv", "NHDPlusHD flowline download log",
  "prism_file_inventory.csv", "PRISM normals download log",
  "prism_qc.csv", "PRISM normals download quality control",
  "raster_data_inventory.csv", "data/processed raster data inventory",
  "summary_processed_data_files.csv", "data/processed feature and raster data inventory",
  "summary_raw_data_files.csv", "data/raw feature and raster data inventory",
  "raster_error_recheck.csv", "data/processed raster data QC",
  "raster_validation_summary.csv", "data/processed raster data QC",
  "vector_bbox_summary.csv", "data/processed feature data QC",
  "vector_bbox_suspects.csv", "data/processed feature data QC",
  "vector_validation_summary.csv", "data/processed feature data QC"
)

metadata_files <- left_join(metadata_files, file_descriptions, by = "file_name")


# 2. Render the table
metadata_files %>%
  select(Folder = folder,
         `File Name` = file_name,
         Extension = ext, Size = size_display,
         Description = description) %>%
  kable(align = "lcc")
```
